label: More and less in being
term: more and less in being (the order of degrees of being)
resolution: `MoreIn esse` is one primitive comparative in every result; this record says which order model each use takes. Their order shapes need not differ: when every represented being has the perfection (`∀ x, InAct x r`), an order by approach to a primary is a homogeneous scale for the preorder pulled back along `near` (`ApproachToPrimaryReading.homogeneousLift`). Universal possession is an additional condition: the attribution reading itself requires only the primary to have the perfection. Strict primacy of one distinguished being (DEF-STRICT-PRIMACY) and the causal clause of q.13 a.5 are further separate premises. Aquinas' sense is the attribution order (q.3 a.5 ad 2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A5-AD2-APPROACH-ORDER-A), which attributes only the order by approach. Strict primacy is not attributed to q.3 a.5 ad 2: it is the separate open premise STMT-NOTHING-ELSE-REACHES-THE-PRIMARY, with no claim, taken as an explicit hypothesis where it is load-bearing (QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING, QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-UNIQUE-MAXIMUM). Likewise q.13 a.5 speaks of creatures; that everything other than the primary is a creature is the open premise STMT-OTHERS-THAN-PRIMARY-ARE-CREATURES. Verdicts on the frontier premises: (1) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS: on the homogeneous scale the order gives it no support but is consistent with it (STMT-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE-GIVES-NO-CAUSE-OF-BEING); on the attribution order its instance at being is derived from the order by approach, strict primacy, the causal order of creatures to the primary and the creature premise (STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS), so at being it survives re-read as a consequence of q.3 a.5 ad 2 and q.13 a.5 plus two open metaphysical premises and excluded middle, while the principle for other perfections stays open. (2) STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: its source sense is synonymous (Met. II.1, 993b24-26: the synonymous quality), the univocal sense, where it is consistent but unsupported; on the attribution order with strict primacy it holds for the primary as cause and fails in general (STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH). It therefore needs re-reading at being: restricted to the primary it is derivable, and the AT-MOST-ONE route uses it only there; applied with the primary as effect (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING) it is neither derivable on the attribution order nor available in its synonymous sense, since q.13 a.5 (arg. 1 and ad 1) denies that the first agent is a univocal cause; that use equivocates unless separately sourced. (3) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING: neither order yields it, even with the causal order and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (STMT-ORDER-READINGS-DO-NOT-YIELD-FIRST-BEING). On the attribution order with strict primacy the maximum is the primary, so the bridge reduces to: nothing other than the primary is simply prior to it; it stays open. (4) STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM at esse: on the homogeneous scale the order gives it no support but is consistent with it: the existing Boolean interpretation satisfies it and the existing Nat scale violates it (QUARTA-VIA-DEGREE-BRANCH-WITNESSES, QUARTA-VIA-FORK-UNBOUNDED-ELIMINATED). On the attribution order with strict primacy, a maximum in esse exists without the principle, since the primary is maximal (ApproachToPrimaryReading.isMaximumIn_primary), so the instance at esse holds there conditionally on the open strict-primacy premise; without strict primacy no support is certified. The principle at other respects stays open on both orders. NECESSARY-ROOT-IS-MAXIMUM, MAXIMUM-FIRST-FROM-NECESSARY-ROOT and NECESSARY-ROUTE-CONTROLS take MoreIn as a free parameter and assume no order model. Source-attribution correction2026-11-01: AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIMUM-CAUSES-GENUS-A now supports STMT-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS, using DEF-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-A-PERFECTION. It does not support the old unrestricted maximality principle I or its fixed-esse instance Iesse. Greatest represented degree allows ties without strict supremacy or uniqueness. The weak maximal abstraction can preserve a weaker existential consequence of greatestness under an appropriate order interpretation (as with H); putting it in an implication antecedent instead strengthens the causal conditional. No old definition, proof premise or formal consequence changes, and no totality or source-to-old-I bridge is supplied. Verdict 2026-11-12 for 'A distinct cause of a thing's being is more in being than it' (cffad050): it is the instance at esse of the formal reading STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH with the same free MoreIn, not the synonymous source sense; it assumes no order model. STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH shows that on the attribution order with strict primacy only the restriction to the primary as cause (PrimaryCauseIsMoreSuchReading) is certified, so which order model, if any, makes cffad050 hold for every distinct cause of being is open.
